x-m-el-ai-02.title: Gadzira data rine avhareji 6 asi zvinowanzoitika 4
x-m-el-ai-02.goal: Gadzira, iwe pachako, seti yedata rakaumbwa kuti avhareji ibude yakakura kupfuura median, uye utsanangure chikonzero uchishandisa nhamba dziri mumuenzaniso wako.
x-m-el-ai-02.material: Nhamba shanu dzechisikigo, kubva padiki kusvika pakuru, ndi a, b, c, d, e. (a ≤ b ≤ c ≤ d ≤ e) Avhareji yenhamba shanu idzi ndi 6 uye median ndi 4. (Median ndiko kukosha kwepakati kana nhamba dzakarongwa nesaizi. Nenhamba shanu, c ndiyo median.)
x-m-el-ai-02.thinking.0: Gadzira masiti akasiyana edata anosangana nemamiriro
x-m-el-ai-02.thinking.1: Tsanangura kuti sei avhareji nemedian zvakasiyana
x-m-el-ai-02.thinking.2: Taura pamusoro pezvekungwarira pakusarudza kukosha kunomiririra
x-m-el-ai-02.prereq.0: Zvinoreva avhareji (huwandu ÷ huwandu hwekukosha) nemedian (kukosha kwepakati kana kwarongwa nesaizi)
x-m-el-ai-02.prereq.1: Kuverenga kuti kuwirirane nehuwandu hwenhamba dzakazara shanu
x-m-el-ai-02.s.s1.prompt: Avhareji yenhamba shanu yakabuda yakakura kupfuura median. Data rinowanzova nechimiro chei?
x-m-el-ai-02.s.s1.hint.0: Funga kuti avhareji kana median ndiyo inokanganiswa zvakanyanya nekukosha kukuru.
x-m-el-ai-02.s.s1.hint.1: Gadzira muenzaniso mudiki (1, 2, 3 ne 1, 2, 30) uye uenzanise kukosha kuviri.
x-m-el-ai-02.s.s1.o.a: Kukosha kwese kwakafanana uye kwakaunganidzwa pakati
x-m-el-ai-02.s.s1.r.a: Kana kukosha kwese kwakafanana, avhareji nemedian zvinenge zvakaenzana. Ichocho hachisi chikonzero chekuti kukosha kuviri kuparadzane.
x-m-el-ai-02.s.s1.o.b: Kukosha kushoma kudiki kwakadzika zvikuru kupfuura kwakasara
x-m-el-ai-02.s.s1.r.b: Kana kukosha kudiki kuri kure, avhareji inodhonzwa kurutivi rudiki. Ndiko kupesana neavhareji kuva yakakura zvino.
x-m-el-ai-02.s.s1.o.c: Kukosha kushoma kukuru kwakakura zvikuru kupfuura kwakasara
x-m-el-ai-02.s.s1.r.c: Iyi i pfungwa inoshandisa chokwadi chekuti mitengo mikuru inokwidza mean nepo median ichiwana pamusoro penzvimbo yepakati chete.
x-m-el-ai-02.s.s1.r.d: Kana yakafanana, mean ne median zvakaenzana. Haigone kutsanangura nei mean i hombe.
x-m-el-ai-02.s.s1.explain: Mean inoratidza hukuru hwemutengo wega wega, asi median i mutengo mumwe chete uri panzvimbo yepakati. Kana pane mutengo mukuru zvikuru, mean chete ndiyo inokwira zvakanyanya.
x-m-el-ai-02.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira seti 3 dzakasiyana dzenhamba shanu dzakazara dzinogutsa mamiriro. Mamiriro: ① a ≤ b ≤ c ≤ d ≤ e ② huwandu i 30 (mean 6) ③ median c = 4 ④ e chete ndiyo yakakura kupfuura mean 6 (d i 6 kana pasi).
x-m-el-ai-02.s.s2.hint.0: Huwandu i 30, saka kana wasarudza a, b, ne d, e inosarudzwa pachayo.
x-m-el-ai-02.s.s2.hint.1: Chengeta d kubva ku 4 kusvika ku 6 uye a ne b pa 4 kana pasi, verenga e, uye utarise kana e i yakakura kupfuura 6.
x-m-el-ai-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Nhamba shanu dzose dzinofanira kuva natural numbers dzine 1 kana kupfuura.
x-m-el-ai-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Hadziri munhevedzano a ≤ b ≤ c ≤ d ≤ e.
x-m-el-ai-02.s.s2.ok.c5: e chete ndiyo yakakura kupfuura mean 6.
x-m-el-ai-02.s.s2.fail.c5: d inofanira kuva 6 kana pasi uye e inofanira kuva yakakura kupfuura 6.
x-m-el-ai-02.s.s2.explain: Ne c = 4 ne d ≤ 6, a+b+d i 4+4+6 = 14 zvakanyanya zvisinei, saka e inofanira kuva 30−4−14 = 12 kana kupfuura. Wakachengeta median pa 4 uye wakaita e chete hombe kuunza mean kusvika ku 6.
x-m-el-ai-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Sarudza mumwe wemienzaniso yawakagadzira, tsanangura nenhamba dzayo kuti nei mean yakava hombe kupfuura median, uye unyore zvaunofanira kungwarira kana uchitsanangura chii “chakajairika” kune data yerudzi urwu.
x-m-el-ai-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Tarisa chikamu chinotorwa nenhamba hombe e muhuwandu.
x-m-el-ai-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Funga kuti mutengo upi unoonekwa nemunzwi kana uchitaura mean chete.
x-m-el-ai-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakatsanangura nei mean ne median zvakasiyana uchishandisa nhamba dzemuenzaniso wawakasarudza here?
x-m-el-ai-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakafunga nezve “kuti zvaizonzwika sei kana ukataura mean chete” here?
x-m-el-ai-02.s.s2.because.model.0: Semuenzaniso, ne 2, 3, 4, 5, 16, mutengo mumwe mukuru sa 16 unokwidza mean kusvika ku 6, saka i yakakura kupfuura median 4. Saka kana ukashandisa mean chete kutaura chii chakajairika, zvinoratidzika zvakakura.
x-m-el-ai-02.s.s2.because.model.1: Mu 1, 1, 4, 4, 20, 20 imwe chete inoita huwandu hukuru saka mean inokwira, asi median i mutengo wepakati 4, saka inoramba yakadaro. Kana ukataura mean chete, inonzwika yakakwirira kupfuura mitengo yakawanda yechokwadi.

x-m-el-ai-01.title: Avhareji ndi maawa 3.2; maawa mangani ndiwo “anowanzoitika” kukirasi yedu?
x-m-el-ai-01.goal: Mudata rine kukosha kumwe kwakakura zvikuru, tonga uchishandisa humbowo kuti avhareji ne median zvinotaura zvinhu zvakasiyana, wobva wasarudza kukosha kunoratidza zvinonzi “zvinowanzoitika” uye utsanangure kuti sei.
x-m-el-ai-01.material:
Huwandu hwemaawa (maawa akazara) avadzidzi 10 mukirasi vakapedza vachitamba mitambo yeherekedhi nezuro, yakanyorwa kubva pashoma kuenda pakuru, ndiizvi.
1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 2, 3, 3, 3, 13
Avhareji ndi maawa 3.2. Mudzidzi anopa mharidzo akati, "Avhareji ndi maawa 3.2, saka vadzidzi vekirasi yedu vanowanzotamba mitambo kwemaawa anenge 3."
(Kukosha kunowanzoitika kunosanganisira avhareji, median, ne mode. Avhareji ndiko kukosha kwaunowana nekuwedzera zvese uye kukamura nehuwandu hwekukosha. Median ndiko kukosha kwepakati kana data rakarongwa nesaizi (kana huwandu hwekukosha huri hwakaenzana, avhareji yezvikamu zviviri zvepakati). Mode ndiko kukosha kunooneka kazhinji.)
x-m-el-ai-01.thinking.0: Ongorora nehumbowo kuti kukosha kunomiririra kunotsanangura data zvakanaka here
x-m-el-ai-01.thinking.2: Tarisa kukosha kwakapfupiswa nedata repakutanga pamwe chete
x-m-el-ai-01.prereq.0: Kuziva kuti avhareji, median, ne mode rimwe nerimwe chii (padanho resekondari)
x-m-el-ai-01.s.s1.prompt: Pakutonga kana mharidzo inowirirana nedata, humbowo hunodenha zvakanyanya ndohupi?
x-m-el-ai-01.s.s1.hint.0: Verenga kuti vadzidzi vangani vakatamba pasi pemaawa avhareji 3.2 uye vangani vakatamba zvakawanda.
x-m-el-ai-01.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa kuti avhareji inoshanduka sei kana ukabvisa kukosha kwemaawa 13 uye ukaiwana zvakare.
x-m-el-ai-01.s.s1.o.a: Avhareji 3.2 inowanikwa nekuwedzera kukosha kwese uye kukamura, saka ndiko kukosha kunomiririra kunovimbika zvakanyanya
x-m-el-ai-01.s.s1.r.a: Kushandisa kukosha kwese kunogona kuva simba, asi hauna kufunga kuti kana kukosha kumwe kwakakura zvikuru, kunodhonza avhareji kumusoro.
x-m-el-ai-01.s.s1.o.b: Vadzidzi 6 pa 10 vakatamba maawa 2 kana pasi, saka hazvienderani ne “kazhinji maawa 3”
x-m-el-ai-01.s.s1.r.b: Kutonga uku hakuna kungotarisa nhamba yeavhareji; kwakaverenga kuti vadzidzi vanounganidzwa papi chaizvo.
x-m-el-ai-01.s.s1.o.c: Maawa 13 anofanira kuva kanganiso, saka aadze uye uwane avhareji zvakare
x-m-el-ai-01.s.s1.r.c: Kudzima kukosha pasina chikonzero kunoshandura data. Tanga watarisa kuti kukosha uko kunokanganisa mhedzisiro zvakadini.
x-m-el-ai-01.s.s1.o.d: 3.2 idecimal, saka zvakaoma kuitaura mumaawa; 3 yakatenderedzwa yakarurama
x-m-el-ai-01.s.s1.r.d: Wakatarisa kurongedza kwekuoneka kwenhamba. Hauna kutarisa kana 3 iri padyo nenguva chaiyo yekushandisa yevadzidzi.
x-m-el-ai-01.s.s1.explain: 1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 2 ndi vadzidzi 6, vakawanda kupfuura hafu, uye vadzidzi 4 chete vakatamba maawa 3 kana kupfuura: 3, 3, 3, 13. Mudzidzi mumwe ane maawa 13 akaita kuti huwandu hukure uye akadhonza avhareji kusvika pa 3.2. Median (pakati pekukosha kwe 5 ne 6) ndi maawa 2.
x-m-el-ai-01.s.s2.prompt: Dai wakazivisa zvinowanzoitika kukirasi iyi mumutsara mumwe, kukosha kunomiririra kupi (avhareji, median, kana mode, chero) kwaungashandisa, uye waizoita sei nekukosha kwemaawa 13? Nyora zvikonzero zvako.
x-m-el-ai-01.s.s2.hint.0: Verenga nenhamba kuti kukosha kunomiririra kwega kwega kunotsanangura vadzidzi vangani.
x-m-el-ai-01.s.s2.hint.1: Tarisa kana kukosha kwawasarudza kuri padyo nevadzidzi vazhinji mukirasi iyi.
x-m-el-ai-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakatarisa here nenhamba dzedata kuti kukosha kwawasarudza kunoratidza “vadzidzi vazhinji”?
x-m-el-ai-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakasarudza here kuti ungaita sei nemaawa 13 pasina kuadzima?
x-m-el-ai-01.s.s2.model.0: Median ndi maawa 2. Avhareji yakakwira kusvika pa 3.2 nekuda kwemudzidzi mumwe ane maawa 13, saka zvinowirirana nedata zvakanyanya kutaura kuti zvinowanzoitika zvekirasi iyi zvinenge median, maawa 2, kupfuura avhareji.
x-m-el-ai-01.s.s2.model.1: Ndicharatidza avhareji ye maawa 3.2 nemedian ye maawa 2 pamwe chete. Kana pane kukosha kunobuda ega, sa maawa 13, avhareji oga inoita kuti zvakaoma kuziva zvinowanzoitika, uye ndichatsanangura kukosha uko zvakasiyana panzvimbo pekukudzima.

x-m-el-ai-03.title: Kana huwandu hwema errors i 0, model yakakwana here?
x-m-el-ai-03.goal: Ona kuti kungowedzera ma errors kunogona kuita kuti zviratidzo zvidzimane, uye gadzirisa kuti ma errors anofanira kubatanidzwa sei kana uchienzanisa mamodel.
x-m-el-ai-03.material:
Mamodel A ne B akagadzirwa neklabhu akafungidzira ma test scores evadzidzi 4. Error inoverengwa se (score yakafungidzirwa − score chaiyo).
Ma errors e Model A: +4, −4, +6, −6
Ma errors e Model B: +1, +1, +1, +1
Pazasi pane kuti mudzidzi mumwe akaenzanisa sei mamodel maviri.
x-m-el-ai-03.thinking.1: Enzanisa mamodel maviri uchishandisa chiyero chimwechete
x-m-el-ai-03.prereq.0: Zvinoreva error = mutengo wakafungidzirwa − mutengo chaiwo
x-m-el-ai-03.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse mumwe mugadziriso apo mhedziso isingaenderane nekuverenga kwapfuura.
x-m-el-ai-03.s.s1.hint.0: Kune mudzidzi mumwe nemumwe muna A, tarisa kana fungidziro yakaenzana ne score chaiyo.
x-m-el-ai-03.s.s1.hint.1: Funga kana huwandu i 0 nema errors ose ari 0 zvichireva zvakafanana.
x-m-el-ai-03.s.s1.line.0: Ma errors e Model A (fungidziro − chaiyo): +4, −4, +6, −6
x-m-el-ai-03.s.s1.line.2: Huwandu hwema errors i 0, saka Model A inofungidzira zvose zvakanyatsonaka.
x-m-el-ai-03.s.s1.line.3: Ma errors e Model B i ma +1 mana uye huwandu i 4, saka B i yakaipa pakufungidzira kupfuura A.
x-m-el-ai-03.s.s1.explain: Mutsetse 3: Ma errors ane zviratidzo zvakapesana sa +4 ne −4, saka huwandu hwakangoitika kuva 0; chaizvo A yakanga yakasiyana ne 4 kusvika 6 points kumudzidzi mumwe nemumwe. Mutsetse 4: B, ine huwandu hwe 4, yakanga yakasiyana ne 1 point chete nguva imwe neimwe, saka ma errors ayo i madiki chaizvo. Mutsetse 5 i mhedziso inovimba nemitsetse miviri iyi, saka inowira nayo.
x-m-el-ai-03.s.s2.prompt: Nyora kuti ndeipi pakati pe A ne B inofungidzira zvakanyatsonaka, uye kuti unofanira kubatanidza sei ma errors kuti utonge izvozvo.
x-m-el-ai-03.s.s2.hint.0: Funga kana uchida chiratidzo kana uchitarisa chete “kuti mudzidzi mumwe nemumwe akasiyana zvakadini.”
x-m-el-ai-03.s.s2.hint.1: Verenga hukuru hwekuti A ne B dzakasiyana zvakadini uchishandisa nzira imwechete uye uenzanise.
x-m-el-ai-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakaenzanisa “huwandu hwe error” hwemamodel maviri nenhamba here?
x-m-el-ai-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakatarisa kuti nzira yako haiti ma errors ane zviratidzo zvakapesana adzimane here?
x-m-el-ai-03.s.s2.model.0: B i nyatsonaka zvikuru. Ma errors e A anodzimana sa +4 ne −4 saka huwandu hunova 0, asi kana ukatora avhareji yema absolute values, A i 5 uye B i 1.
x-m-el-ai-03.s.s2.model.1: Kana ukaita ma errors square uye ukaawedzera, A i 16+16+36+36=104 uye B i 4, saka kusarudza B kwakarurama. Ma errors ane zviratidzo zvakapesana anodzimana, saka haufaniri kungoaawedzera.

x-m-el-ai-04.title: Mutsetse unofungidzira ma scores kubva panguva yekudzidza: tinogona kuvimba nawo zvakadini?
x-m-el-ai-04.goal: Siyanisa mafungidziro ari kunze kwerenji ye data (extrapolation) nemafungidziro ari mukati mayo, uye gadzirisa kuvimba kwako nemafungidziro nguva imwe neimwe ruzivo rutsva rwabuda.
x-m-el-ai-04.material:
Pachikoro chimwe, vadzidzi 5 vakaongororwa nezvenguva yekudzidza yezuva nezuva (maawa 1 kusvika 5) ne mock exam score (kubva pa 100).
(nguva yekudzidza, score): (awa 1, 55), (maawa 2, 65), (maawa 3, 75), (maawa 4, 85), (maawa 5, 95)
Mutsetse score = 45 + 10 × nguva yekudzidza wakapfuura mapoinzi ose mashanu.

x-m-el-ai-04.thinking.2: Siyanisa fungidziro nemusiyano wemunhu mumwe nemumwe

x-m-el-ai-04.s.s1.hint.0: Tanga waenzanisa kana mutengo wakafungidzirwa unogoneka muhupenyu chaihwo.

x-m-el-ai-04.s.s1.st.0.info: Kana ukaisa maawa 6 mumutsetse, unowana 45 + 10 × 6 = 105 points.

x-m-el-ai-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Mutsetse wakapfuura mapoinzi ose mashanu, saka vimba ne 105 points sezvayakaita

x-m-el-ai-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wakachinja mutengo pasina chikonzero. Hapana humbowo kubva pa data hwekuti nei unomira.
x-m-el-ai-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Full score i 100, saka 105 haigone kuitika, uye kunze kwerenji yakaongororwa (maawa 1 kusvika 5) mutsetse ungasaenderana
x-m-el-ai-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Waenzanisa mutengo wakafungidzirwa nemiganhu yenyika chaiyo uye wakachengeta renji ye data mupfungwa.
x-m-el-ai-04.s.s1.st.0.o.d: 105 yabuda, saka mutsetse wakanganisa uye data iyi haigone kushandiswa

x-m-el-ai-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Vadzidzi vemaawa 7 ne 8 i zvisiri izvo, saka vaite sevasingaonekwi uye ushandise mutsetse sezvawakaita

x-m-el-ai-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Uku i kutonga kunosiyanisa kwainoenderana mutsetse uye kunoedza kugadzirisa model ne data itsva.

x-m-el-ai-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Mutsetse wakabata zvakanaka tsika yeavhareji yevadzidzi vane nguva yekudzidza yakafanana (anenge 80 points), asi score yemunhu mumwe ine error hombe, chero kupi pakati pe 60 ne 90.

x-m-el-ai-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Musiyano we 1 point unoreva kuti mutsetse wakabata zvakanaka tsika yeavhareji. Wakarasa model nekuda kwemusiyano mudiki.
x-m-el-ai-04.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Taura kuti tsika yeavhareji i padyo ne 80 points, asi score yemunhu mumwe inogona kusiyana nayo zvakanyanya
x-m-el-ai-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wakasiyanisa kuti fungidziro i tsika yeavhareji yeboka uye kuti munhu mumwe ane error.
x-m-el-ai-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Hauna kufunga chokwadi chekuti ma scores evadzidzi vakadzidza nguva yakafanana akapararira kubva pa 60 kusvika pa 90.

x-m-el-ai-05.title: Spam filter ine 99% accuracy: tingavimba nayo here?
x-m-el-ai-05.goal: Ziva kuti accuracy oga haikuudze kana classification model inobatsira, sarudza kuti ruzivo rupi rumwe runodiwa, uye vaka iwe pachako mhedzisiro dzine accuracy yakakwirira asi dzisina basa.
x-m-el-ai-05.material: Pakati pema email 1,000, 10 i spam chaizvo uye 990 yasara i ma email akajairika. Kambani inotsvaira spam filter: “Accuracy ye filter yedu i pamusoro pe 99%!” (Accuracy i chikamu chema email akapatsanurwa zvakarurama.)
x-m-el-ai-05.thinking.1: Gadzira mamiriro apo accuracy yakakwirira asi filter isina basa
x-m-el-ai-05.prereq.0: Accuracy = huwandu hwakapatsanurwa zvakarurama ÷ huwandu hwose (sepercentage)
x-m-el-ai-05.s.s1.prompt: Kana wangobvunza mutsigiri maviri chete, ndezvipi zvaungabvunza kuti utonge kana filter iyi inofanira kushandiswa? Sarudza zviviri.
x-m-el-ai-05.s.s1.hint.0: Tanga warongera kuti filter iyi inogona kuita marudzi mangani ekukanganisa.
x-m-el-ai-05.s.s1.hint.1: Funga kuti nhamba ye accuracy inofamba sei kana pane ma email akajairika 990.
x-m-el-ai-05.s.s1.o.a: Pakati pema spam email 10 chaiwo, filter yakabata mangani?
x-m-el-ai-05.s.s1.r.a: Uyu i mubvunzo wekutarisa kuti filter inotadza ma spam email mangani. Wakaona kuti accuracy inovanza chikamu ichi.
x-m-el-ai-05.s.s1.o.b: Kambani yakagadzira filter yakava mumusika kwenguva yakareba zvakadini?
x-m-el-ai-05.s.s1.r.b: Nhoroondo yekambani haikuudze kuti filter iyi yakapatsanura ma email aya zvakanaka zvakadini.
x-m-el-ai-05.s.s1.o.c: Pakati pema email akajairika, mangani akapatsanurwa se spam?
x-m-el-ai-05.s.s1.r.c: Uyu i mubvunzo wekutarisa kuti ma email akajairika akakosha anoenda kufoda ye spam kazhinji zvakadini. Wakasiyanisa marudzi maviri ekukanganisa.
x-m-el-ai-05.s.s1.o.d: Accuracy i percent yei kana yaverengwa kusvika decimal places mbiri?
x-m-el-ai-05.s.s1.r.d: Kunyange kana ukaziva accuracy zvakanyatsonaka, ichiri nhamba imwe chete. Haigone kukuudza kuti ma errors api akavanzwa.
x-m-el-ai-05.s.s1.explain: Kune marudzi maviri ekukanganisa kwekupatsanura: kutadza spam, nekutumira zvisina kururama email yakajairika kuspam. Accuracy i nhamba imwe inosanganisa zviviri izvi, saka kana ma email akajairika akawanda zvikuru, unogona kuwana 99% kunyange usingabate spam chero imwe. Unofanira kuziva huwandu hwerudzi rwega rwega rwekukanganisa kuti utonge kana inofanira kushandiswa.
x-m-el-ai-05.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira mhedzisiro 3 dzakasiyana dze filter ine accuracy ye 97% kana kupfuura asi inobata 3 kana shoma chete pa ma spam email 10 chaiwo. (tp i huwandu hwe spam yakabatwa, fp i huwandu hwema email akajairika akapatsanurwa se spam. Kune ma email akajairika 990, uye akajairika akapatsanurwa zvakarurama i 990−fp.)
x-m-el-ai-05.s.s2.hint.0: Verenga kuti ma email mangani pa 1,000 anofanira kupatsanurwa zvakarurama kuti accuracy ive 97% kana kupfuura.
x-m-el-ai-05.s.s2.hint.1: Sarudza tp pakutanga, wobva wawana kuti fp inogona kuva hombe zvakadini.
x-m-el-ai-05.s.s2.var.fp: Huwandu hwema email akajairika akapatsanurwa zvisina kururama se spam
x-m-el-ai-05.s.s2.fail.c1: Huwandu hwema email hunofanira kuva integers.
x-m-el-ai-05.s.s2.fail.c2: Spam yakabatwa inofanira kuva 0 kusvika 10 uye ma email akajairika akapatsanurwa zvisina kururama anofanira kuva 0 kusvika 990.
x-m-el-ai-05.s.s2.fail.c3: Huwandu hwakapatsanurwa zvakarurama (tp+990−fp) i shoma kupfuura 970, saka accuracy i pasi pe 97%.
x-m-el-ai-05.s.s2.ok.c4: Yakabata 3 kana shoma ma spam email.
x-m-el-ai-05.s.s2.explain: Kana tp = 0 ne fp = 0, kunyange pasina spam yakabatwa, ma email 990 anopatsanurwa zvakarurama, saka accuracy i 99%. Kana ukatarisa accuracy chete, filter isina basa inogona kuwana score yakakwirira.

x-m-el-ai-06.title: Kubva pa score ipi isu tinoiti “positive”?
x-m-el-ai-06.goal: Tarisa ne data kuti kuchinja criterion yekupatsanura (threshold) kunoita kuti ma missed cases nema wrongly caught cases akwire nekudzikira nenzira dzakapesana, uye usarudze criterion inokodzera mamiriro.
x-m-el-ai-06.material:
Modhera yekuongorora chirwere yakapa varwere 10 “risk score” iri pakati pe0 ne1. Kana score iri pa cutoff kana kupfuura, inoiswa se “positive (inoda kuyedzwa zvakare).” Mamiriro chaiwo akasimbiswa shure.
Risk score / mamiriro chaiwo:
0.95 chirwere, 0.85 chirwere, 0.75 hutano, 0.65 chirwere, 0.55 hutano, 0.45 chirwere, 0.35 hutano, 0.25 hutano, 0.15 hutano, 0.05 hutano
x-m-el-ai-06.thinking.0: Kuverenga kukanganisa pachiyero chimwe nechimwe mutafura
x-m-el-ai-06.prereq.1: Marudzi maviri ekukanganisa kuparadzanisa (kusiya, nekubata zvisina kururama) anoreva zvinhu zvakasiyana
x-m-el-ai-06.s.s1.prompt: Kuyedzwa zvakare kwakapfava uye kwakachipa, asi kana chirwere chikasiiwa, kurapwa kunononoka uye zvinotyisa. Chiyero chakanakisa panyaya iyi chii?
x-m-el-ai-06.s.s1.hint.0: Pachiyero chimwe nechimwe, verenga kuti nyaya 4 dzechirwere dzinova positive dzingani.
x-m-el-ai-06.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa kuti ndeupi dambudziko rakakura panyaya iyi: munhu ane hutano kuva positive, kana chirwere kusiiwa.
x-m-el-ai-06.s.s1.r.a: Kana chiyero chakakwira, kubata vanhu vane hutano zvisina kururama se positive kunodzika, asi kusiya zvirwere kunowedzera. Enzanisa kuti divi ripi rinotyisa zvakanyanya panyaya iyi.
x-m-el-ai-06.s.s1.r.b: Chiyero ichi chinoita positive chete kana zvanyatsosimbiswa. Isarudzo yakaitwa pasina kuverenga kuti zvirwere zvingani zvinosiiwa.
x-m-el-ai-06.s.s1.r.c: Iri pakati, saka rinoita senge rakaenzana, asi harina kufunga kuti kukanganisa kupi kwakaipa zvakanyanya panyaya iyi.
x-m-el-ai-06.s.s1.r.d: Iyi isarudzo inoisa pamberi kusasiya chirwere. Panzvimbo payo, huwandu hwevanhu vane hutano vanoiswa se positive hunowedzera.
x-m-el-ai-06.s.s1.explain: Ne0.4 kana kupfuura, nyaya dzose 4 dzechirwere dzinova positive (0.95, 0.85, 0.65, 0.45), uye vanhu 2 vane hutano (0.75, 0.55) vanova positive zvakare. Pa0.5 kana kupfuura, unosiya nyaya 1 yechirwere (0.45), pa0.8 kana kupfuura 2, uye pa0.9 kana kupfuura 3. Kusiya ndicho chinhu chinotyisa zvakanyanya pano, saka 0.4 yakarurama.
x-m-el-ai-06.s.s2.prompt: Zvino fungidzira mamiriro senge “kuona kubiridzira otomatiki,” apo munhu anopomerwa zvisina kururama anotambura zvakanyanya. Zvingava zvakanaka kuchinja chiyero sei? Nyora nzira nezvaunofanira kubvuma, uchishandisa nhamba dziri mutafura iri pamusoro kana tsananguro yakazara.
x-m-el-ai-06.s.s2.hint.0: Funga kuti kukwidza chiyero kunoita kuti vanhu vakawanda kana vashoma vave positive.
x-m-el-ai-06.s.s2.hint.1: Taura kuti chii chinowedzera semutengo wechakadzikira.
x-m-el-ai-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakataura here kuti kushandura chiyero kunoderedza kukanganisa kumwe uye kunowedzera kumwe?
x-m-el-ai-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakatarisa here kuti nhamba kana mienzaniso yawakapa inosangana netafura?
x-m-el-ai-06.s.s2.model.0: Kwidza chiyero. Pa0.8 kana kupfuura, hapana munhu ane hutano anova positive, asi waizosiya vanhu 2 vane chirwere.
x-m-el-ai-06.s.s2.model.1: Kwidza chiyero uye bata chete kana zvakasimbiswa. Panzvimbo payo, unofanira kubvuma kuti vanhu vakawanda vakabiridzira chaizvo havabatwi.

Unogona kushandisa budget ye20만 원 zvakanyanya uye 18 maawa e computer zvakanyanya. Ma experiment anogona kumhanyiswa nhamba yakazara yenguva chete.

x-m-el-ai-07.s.s2.hint.0: Isa 5 ne3 mu expression yebudget nemu expression yenguva.
x-m-el-ai-07.s.s2.hint.1: Unganidza zvirongwa zvenhamba dzakazara chete zvinoteerera miganhu uye uenzanise ma score azvo.
x-m-el-ai-07.s.s2.o.a: Makosha ekupindirana ma decimal, saka hapana hurongwa hunokwanisika hwedambudziko iri
x-m-el-ai-07.s.s2.r.a: Kunyangwe nekupindirana kwe decimal, pane zvirongwa zvakawanda zvenhamba dzakazara. Zvirongwa zvawakagadzira muhanho yapfuura ndezvimwe zvakadaro.
x-m-el-ai-07.s.s2.o.b: Isa zvakananga kuti utarise kuti (5, 3) inoteerera miganhu yebudget nenguva here
x-m-el-ai-07.s.s2.r.b: Kutonga uku kunotarisa kuti makosha akatenderedzwa ari mukati memaconstraint here. Wakaparadzanisa kukosha kwekutanga kwakaverengwa nezvirongwa zvinokwanisika chaizvo.
x-m-el-ai-07.s.s2.o.c: Nguva dze decimal dzekumhanya hadzigoni kushandiswa, saka kutenderedza kunogara kuri kwakanakisa mukati memiganhu
x-m-el-ai-07.s.s2.r.c: Hapana chivimbiso chekuti kutenderedza kunoteerera miganhu. Wakaita generalization pasina kuisa makosha kutarisa.

x-m-el-ai-07.s.s2.r.d: Kana ukaverenga ma score 4x+3y ezvirongwa zviviri, haazi akafanana. Hauna kutarisa kuverenga.

x-m-el-ai-10.topic: Kutsvaga nyaya apo modhera isina kururama
x-m-el-ai-10.title: Nguva apo classifier yekatsi/imbwa ye98% accuracy inokanganisa
x-m-el-ai-10.goal: Ongorora zvakare, zvichienderana neruzivo rwakawedzerwa, kuti accuracy yakakwira inoratidza kugona chaiko kwemodhera here, uye gadzira test data inotsvaga pamberi nyaya apo isina kururama.
x-m-el-ai-10.material: Pane modhera ye AI inotarisa mufananidzo wotarira se “katsi” kana “imbwa.” Pamifananidzo 500 yekuyedza yakaunganidzwa nemugadziri, accuracy yaiva 98%.
x-m-el-ai-10.s.s1.prompt: Ruzivo runoratidzwa chimwe nechimwe. Nguva imwe neimwe, sarudza kutonga kwakanakisa nezve modhera iyi.
x-m-el-ai-10.s.s1.hint.0: Tarisa kuti ruzivo rumwe nerumwe runokuudza chii nezve “98% yakabva pamamiriro api.”
x-m-el-ai-10.s.s1.hint.1: Ronga hukama hwaive pakati pemhuka nezvakatenderedza mumifananidzo yekudzidzisa.
x-m-el-ai-10.s.s1.st.0.ask: Unofunga kuti modhera iyi ichawana mufananidzo mutsva zvakarurama zvakadini?
x-m-el-ai-10.s.s1.st.0.after: Pano uchiri kusaziva kuti modhera inoshandisa chii mumufananidzo kuwana zvakarurama. Zvose zviviri kutarisira kwekuti “ichaita zvakafanana zvakanaka kana mifananidzo yakaunganidzwa nenzira imwe chete neyemuyedzo” nekuchenjera kwekuti “inogona kuva yakaderera kana yakasiyana” zvinonzwisisika.
x-m-el-ai-10.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Kana mifananidzo yakaunganidzwa senge mifananidzo yemuyedzo, tarisira anenge 98% yakarurama
x-m-el-ai-10.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wakaverenga accuracy semhedzisiro pasi pemamiriro akafanana nemuyedzo.
x-m-el-ai-10.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Ndi98%, saka inowana mufananidzo mutsva wese 98% zvakarurama
x-m-el-ai-10.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Pamifananidzo iri mumamiriro akasiyana nemifananidzo yetest, inogona kuva yakaderera
x-m-el-ai-10.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Waiziva kuti mhedzisiro inogona kuchinja pamifananidzo iri mumamiriro akasiyana netest.
x-m-el-ai-10.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Nhamba yeaccuracy haina zvayinoreva, saka haugoni kuziva chinhu
x-m-el-ai-10.s.s1.st.1.info: Mifananidzo yemakatsi yakawanda yakashandiswa pakudzidzisa yakatorwa mukati meimba, uye mifananidzo yembwa yakawanda yakatorwa pamuti kana kunze. Mifananidzo yetest yakaunganidzwa nenzira imwe chete.
x-m-el-ai-10.s.s1.st.1.ask: Tinogona kutaura kuti 98% accuracy inoratidza "kugona kusiyanisa makatsi nembwa" here?
x-m-el-ai-10.s.s1.st.1.after: Kana pane mutemo wepamberi wekuti katsi = mukati meimba, mbwa = kunze, accuracy yakakwirira inogona kubva pamberi bedzi, pasina kutarisa mhuka. Test yakaunganidzwa nenzira imwe chete, saka kusimba kushoma hakuna kuonekwa.
x-m-el-ai-10.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Hongu, inoratidza zvakakwana. Nokuti test accuracy yakakwirira
x-m-el-ai-10.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Hauna kuongorora kana ruzivo rutsva, rwekuti mifananidzo yetest yakaunganidzwa nenzira imwe chete nekudzidzisa, rwunokanganisa mhedziso iyi.
x-m-el-ai-10.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Makatsi nembwa mhuka dzisingagoni kusiyaniswa nemifananidzo pakutanga
x-m-el-ai-10.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Usati wazivisa kuti hazvigoni kusiyaniswa, unofanira kutanga wabvunza kuti modhel yakatarisa chii.
x-m-el-ai-10.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Zvinogona kunge zvakawana mhinduro dzakarurama kubva pamberi chete, saka hatisati tichiziva
x-m-el-ai-10.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wakagadzira nzira ipfupi (pamberi) sehypothesis yekuti nei accuracy yakakwirira. Itongero rinogona kuvandudzwa nenzira yekuongorora.
x-m-el-ai-10.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Pamberi pakasiyana nemufananidzo nemufananidzo, saka modhel haigoni kuva yakazvidzidza
x-m-el-ai-10.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Wakaverenga zvichipesana: pamberi pakava chiratidzo chinogara chakadaro, chinosiyanisa.
x-m-el-ai-10.s.s1.st.2.info: Kana mifananidzo 20 yemakatsi akagara pamuti yakaedzwa, 14 yakagoverwa se "mbwa." Pamifananidzo 20 yembwa dzakagara pasofa remukati, 15 yakagoverwa se "katsi."
x-m-el-ai-10.s.s1.st.2.after: Accuracy yakadzika zvikuru pamifananidzo ine pamberi pakasanganiswa (makatsi 14 pa20 nembwa 15 pa20 dzakagoverwa zvisiri izvo). Chete kana wawana nyaya dzinoitwa zvisiri izvo nemodhel ndipo paunoona nzira yekugadzirisa.
x-m-el-ai-10.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Enderera mberi nekugadzirisa kuti accuracy ikwire kubva pa98% kusvika pa99% pamifananidzo imwe chete yetest
x-m-el-ai-10.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Kunyange kana ukakwidza nhamba patest imwe chete, nzira ipfupi yepamberi inoramba iripo.
x-m-el-ai-10.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Isa mifananidzo ine pamberi pakasanganiswa, seembwa mukati meimba nemakatsi kunze, mukudzidzisa netest zvose
x-m-el-ai-10.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Uku kutonga kuti unofanira kuchinja data kuti pamberi nemhuka zvisanganiswe, kuti modhel itarise mhuka pachayo.
x-m-el-ai-10.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Bvisa mifananidzo inoitwa zvisiri izvo nemodhel nekuda kwepamberi mutest kuti uchengete accuracy
x-m-el-ai-10.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wakabvisa nyaya dzakaipa uye wakangochengetedza nhamba. Kusimba kushoma kunoramba kuripo.
x-m-el-ai-10.s.s1.st.2.o.d: AI haigoni kusiyanisa mbwa nemakatsi, saka rega
